plugin.name: WhatRoom
plugin.author: Kelaire
plugin.purpose: Tell you what room you're in.
plugin.description: .----------------------------------------------------------------------------. | WhatRoom Status Window | |----------------------------------------------------------------------------| |whatroom help -- Brings up the help section. (What you are reading now) | | | |whatroom show -- Start displaying the miniwindow. | |whatroom hide -- Stop displaying the miniwindow. | |whatroom reset -- Resets miniwindow data. | | | '----------------------------------------------------------------------------'

muclient.script:
require "serialize" require "gmcphelper"
-- Window variables local z_order_plugin = "462b665ecb569efbf261422f" local dragStart = nil local window = {} local WINDOW_STATE_KEY = "window" local colours = { header = "#474747", } local headerSize = 17
-- On install, reset, get data, and draw the window. function OnPluginInstall() resetRoomData() SetWindowDefaults() -- Prefer individual saved coordinates. Fall back to the legacy table once. local x = tonumber(GetVariable("position_x")) local y = tonumber(GetVariable("position_y")) if x and y then window.left, window.top = x, y window.width = tonumber(GetVariable("position_width")) or window.width window.height = tonumber(GetVariable("position_height")) or window.height local visible = GetVariable("position_visible") if visible ~= nil then window.show = (visible == "1") end else local saved = GetVariable(WINDOW_STATE_KEY) if saved and saved ~= "" then local f = loadstring("return " .. saved) if f then local ok, old = pcall(f) if ok and type(old) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(old) do window[k] = v end end end end end window.id = "window_" .. GetPluginID() InitializeWindow() end
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) if (id == '3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264') then if (text == 'room.info') then gmcpchar = gmcp("room") roomNum = gmcpchar.info.num Draw(window) end if (text == 'comm.tick') then if initialize_config then return else Execute("look") initialize_config = true end end end end
function OnPluginConnect() initialize_config = false end
function OnPluginDisable() SaveWindow() if window.id then WindowShow(window.id, false) end end
function OnPluginClose() SaveWindow() end
function OnPluginSaveState() -- Never call SaveState() here: this callback is invoked by SaveState(). WriteWindowVariables() end
-- Window Defaults function SetWindowDefaults() window = { id = "window_" .. GetPluginID(), top = 10, left = 10, width = 60, height = 35, show = true, font = "defaultFont", fontFamily = "Consolas", fontSize = 9, fontColor = "white", borderColor = "lightgray", backgroundColor = "black" } end
-- Initialize the Window function InitializeWindow() WindowCreate(window.id, window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height, miniwin.pos_top_left, bit.bor(miniwin.create_keep_hotspots, miniwin.create_absolute_location), ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor)) WindowFont(window.id, window.font, window.fontFamily, window.fontSize, false, false, false, false, 1, 0) WindowPosition(window.id, window.left, window.top, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location)
if (window.show) then WindowShow(window.id, window.show) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) end CreateHotSpots() end
-- Create the Hot Spots function CreateHotSpots() WindowDeleteAllHotspots(window.id)
-- Drag window WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "DragArea", 0, 0, window.width-15, headerSize, "", "", "", "", "mouseup", "Drag to move", miniwin.cursor_both_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "DragArea", "dragmove", "dragrelease", 0)
-- Resize window WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Resize", window.width-13, window.height-13, window.width-2, window.height-2,"", "", "", "", "mouseup", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "Resize", "resizemove", "resizerelease", 0)
-- Close button (x) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "CloseMiniwindow", window.width-15, 0, window.width, 15, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) end
-- Show the window function ShowWindow() window.show = true WindowShow(window.id, true) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() SaveWindow() end
-- Hide the window function HideWindow() window.show = false WindowShow(window.id, false) Draw(window) SaveWindow() end
-- Reset to defaults function ResetWindow() SetWindowDefaults() SaveWindow() InitializeWindow() Draw(window) end
-- Save save save! function PositionDebug() ColourNote("cyan", "black", "Window live: " .. tostring(WindowInfo(window.id, 10)) .. ", " .. tostring(WindowInfo(window.id, 11))) ColourNote("cyan", "black", "Window memory: " .. tostring(window.left) .. ", " .. tostring(window.top)) ColourNote("cyan", "black", "Window saved: " .. tostring(GetVariable("position_x")) .. ", " .. tostring(GetVariable("position_y"))) end
function WriteWindowVariables() SetVariable("position_x", tostring(window.left)) SetVariable("position_y", tostring(window.top)) SetVariable("position_width", tostring(window.width)) SetVariable("position_height", tostring(window.height)) SetVariable("position_visible", window.show and "1" or "0") end
function SaveWindow() WriteWindowVariables() local result = SaveState() if result ~= 0 then ColourNote("white", "red", "[Window Position] SaveState failed: " .. tostring(result)) end end
-- Let's do the thing and draw the window! function Draw(win) -- miniwin background WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, win.width, win.height, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor))
-- resize bars WindowLine(win.id, win.width-3, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-3, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-4, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-4, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-6, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-6, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-7, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-7, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-9, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-9, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-10, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-10, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-12, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-12, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-13, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-13, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1)
-- Header WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, window.width, headerSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.header)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Room", (window.width)/2-(WindowTextWidth(win.id, win.font, "Room")/2), 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "x", window.width-9, 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true)
-- Window outline WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect , 0, 0, win.width, win.height, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor))
-- Window Text (Status Type) local roomText = tostring(roomNum or "") WindowText(win.id, win.font, roomText, (window.width)/2-(WindowTextWidth(win.id, win.font, roomText)/2), 20, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("#b942f5"), true)
end
-- Handlers function dragmove(flags, hotspot_id) if (not dragStart) then dragStart = { x = WindowInfo(window.id, 14), y = WindowInfo(window.id, 15), } end
WindowPosition(window.id, WindowInfo(window.id, 17) - dragStart.x, WindowInfo(window.id, 18) - dragStart.y, miniwin.pos_stretch_to_view, miniwin.create_absolute_location) end
function dragrelease(flags, hotspot_id) window.left = WindowInfo(window.id, 10) window.top = WindowInfo(window.id, 11)
dragStart = nil
SaveWindow() end
function resizemove(flags, hotspot_id) window.width = WindowInfo(window.id, 17) - WindowInfo(window.id, 10) window.height = WindowInfo(window.id, 18) - WindowInfo(window.id, 11)
WindowResize(window.id, window.width, window.height, ColourNameToRGB("gray")) WindowShow(window.id, true) end
function resizerelease(flags, hotspot_id) SaveWindow() Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() end
function mouseup(flags, hotspot_id) if (bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0) then local result = WindowMenu(window.id, WindowInfo(window.id, 14), WindowInfo(window.id, 15), "Bring to front|Send to back")
if (result ~= "" and IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then if result == "Send to back" then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "dropMe", window.id) else CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end end end end
function buttonmouseup(flags, hotspot_id) if hotspot_id == "DisplayHelp" then ShowHelp() elseif hotspot_id == "CloseMiniwindow" then HideWindow() end end
function ShowHelp() ColourNote("orange", "black", GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 3)) end
-- DATA Stuff function resetRoomData() roomNum = '' end
